title: Recording: Wings by Ringo Starr | 1977
content:
Atlantic Studios, New York City
Producer: Arif Mardin
Engineer: Lew Hahn

Ringo Starr began recording ‘Wings’ for his sixth studio album, Ringo The 4th, on 11 January 1977.

Written by Starr and Vini Poncia, ‘Wings’ was the lead single from Ringo The 4th in the USA, with the non-album track ‘Just A Dream’ on the b-side. It was released on 25 August 1977 but failed to chart.
